thread:
incidents-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for /v1/generate (hosted-us-west) — p99 = 3.2s (SLO 1.5s) — sustained for 6m. Dash: https://dash.redwood/prod/latency?range=6m&panel=p99 :warning:

miguel (oncall): seeing the alert, joining. severity: p99 breach, p95 up ~900ms. Any customer-facing 5xx?

rachel: not seeing 5xx bump, mostly 200 but slow. A couple streaming sessions report stalled chunks — frontend shows spinner no new tokens.

eli: noted. streaming stalls could be KV cache thrash — recent rollout of kv-cache-heatmap enabled last night?

miguel (oncall): good call. checking rollout status and recent deploys now.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T09:21:33 UTC: rollout/kv-cache-heatmap v2 -> 40% across us-west instances. Commit: 7b4c2f1.

miguel (oncall): that aligns. Querying metrics (promql):
```
rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate",quantile="p99"}[5m])
```
results show tail weight shifted to higher bins after 09:21:30.

ops-bot: CPU on worker-gpu-24 spiked to 98% around same time, memory ok. network EBS latency stable.

rachel: client reports from customer-42: streaming stalled at 2nd chunk repeatedly. I'll open a support note.

miguel (oncall): immediate mitigation options: pause rollout (stop heatmap feature), force fallback to quantized model, or temporarily disable streaming (force non-streaming path). Which is least risky?

eli: quick win is pause rollout. Heatmap code touches cache warming path, likely causing eviction storms. Pause + monitor. I can abort rollout now.

miguel (oncall): do it.

deploy-bot: Rollout abort initiated by eli at 09:28:12 UTC. Rolling back feature flag: kv-cache-heatmap -> OFF for us-west.

incidents-bot: POST-mitigation check scheduled in 2m. p99 decreased to 2.1s after rollback but still above SLO.

miguel (oncall): okay rollback helped but tail is still high. next: increase model replicas in us-west region by +20% and temporarily reduce max-batch-size to 16 to avoid head-of-line tail amplification.

eli: applying autoscaler override now and set max-batch-size=16 on hosted-us-west pool.

ops-bot: Autoscaler override applied, replicas +18% on pooling nodes. max-batch-size change pushed to runtime config at 09:33:01 UTC.

incidents-bot: Observability: p95 -> 680ms, p99 -> 1.4s at 09:36:05 (still slightly above SLO but much improved). Streaming stall reports decreased.

rachel: support update: customer-42 sees progress again. Marking customer impact mitigated for now. I'll keep them in the loop.

miguel (oncall): good. I'll keep monitoring for 30m. eli, can you take the next 30m oncall watch and do a quick postmortem doc with timeline + action items? I'll hand off in 5.

eli: taking watch. Creating incident doc draft under /incidents/p99-spike-2026-03-15. Action items: revert heatmap until full perf test, add canary rate limit on cache warmers, add histogram alert for streaming chunk intervals, add runbook step: "if streaming stalls and no 5xx, check kv eviction and pause heatmap".

miguel (oncall): thanks. Paging: already paged on-call infra and platform. If p99 creeps back >1.8s, escalate to oncall-sre.

sophia: quick note for follow-up: need to add synthetic streaming checks to heartbeat (assert chunk gaps < 300ms). Filing ticket.

incidents-bot: Incident severity reduced to SEV3 (customer impact mitigated, monitoring watch).

eli: handing off active watch to sophia at 09:42:00. I'll update the incident doc and stitch logs + deploy diff.

miguel (oncall): thanks all. Closing initial triage. If anyone sees re-spike, re-open thread. :thumbsup:
